school-management-portal.title: School Management Portal
school-management-portal.problem: Schools needed an intuitive, centralized portal for students, parents, and teachers to track attendance, grades, and schedules.

school-management-portal.result: A high-performance portal with secure role-based access control, responsive dashboards, and grade reporting.

scamshield-ai.title: ScamShield-AI

scamshield-ai.role: Frontend architecture, real-time risk visualization, and FastAPI machine learning integration.
scamshield-ai.result: High-accuracy scam detection engine that parses suspicious text/links and delivers instant risk assessments.

about.title: Engineering Student & Freelance Developer
about.lead: Final-year Software Engineering student and freelance developer, helping businesses, students, and researchers turn ideas into practical digital solutions. I also help researchers and students make AI-assisted writing more natural, clear, and human.
about.p1: I specialize in modern web and mobile application development, focusing on clean architecture, responsiveness, and practical usability. Balancing rigorous final-year university coursework with client projects has given me hands-on experience delivering reliable software under real deadlines.
about.p2: In addition to software engineering, I regularly assist students and researchers with coding problems, project structuring, and technical coursework. Recognizing how widespread AI assistance has become, I also provide an AI-to-Humanize service to help researchers and students refine AI-assisted writing into natural, authentic, and clear prose while preserving its original meaning.

items.question: What technologies do you use for web and mobile development?
items.answer: For web applications, I primarily work with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. For mobile applications, I use React Native or Flutter.

items.question: How do payments and project milestones work?
items.answer: For standard development projects, work is broken into clear milestones. Initial work begins with an upfront deposit, and the remainder is paid upon milestone approvals.

items.question: How does the AI-to-Humanize service work?
items.answer: I review AI-assisted research and technical drafts sentence-by-sentence, eliminating robotic patterns, unnatural cadence, and repetition while maintaining technical accuracy.

items.question: Can we schedule tutoring or mentoring online?
items.answer: Yes! Tutoring is conducted via Google Meet or Zoom, with live screen sharing, collaborative code debugging, and concept walkthroughs tailored to your syllabus.
